sentences.text:
Rajendra Panda @ Tinku Panda .... .... .... Petitioner Versus The State of Jharkhand .... .... .... Opp.
Party Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Gautam Kumar Choudhary For the Petitioner : Mr.
Mohit Prakash, Advocate For the State : Mr. Suraj Deo Munda, A.P.P.

------
Order No.04 Dated : 19.06.2023 Heard both the sides.
The petitioner- Rajendra Panda @ Tinku Panda is in custody since 27.02.2023 in connection with Simdega Mahila P.S. Case No. 06 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 376, 313, 420 of the I.P.C. pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Simdega.
It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that the victim, as per the F.I.R., is 62 years old and the petitioner is 33 years old.
As per the F.I.R., there was consensual physical relationship for six years on false promise of marriage and during this period she became pregnant.
The pregnancy was terminated on the behest of petitioner.
On these materials, offence alleged will not be made out.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.

Under the circumstances, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
